# Texy test sources

The `*.texy` files are vendored from the reference implementation
[github.com/dg/texy](https://github.com/dg/texy) (`tests/Texy/sources`,
BSD-3-Clause). The conformance suites in `../..` parse every source and
compare against the oracle fixtures under `../parse/`, `../passed/`,
`../render/`, … (generated by the `tools/*-oracle.php` scripts of the
porting setup).

To refresh: copy `tests/Texy/sources` from the upstream repo.
